templates.label: Value with quality filter
templates.hypothesis_template: Cheap stocks with sufficient profitability should survive value-trap filtering better than raw value alone.
falsification_criteria: quality-filtered value fails coverage or does not improve neutralized IC versus raw value

templates.label: Industry-relative value
templates.hypothesis_template: Value rankings should be compared within industry to reduce structural sector valuation bias.
falsification_criteria: industry-relative normalization does not improve split stability or neutralization survival

templates.label: Liquidity shock reversal
templates.hypothesis_template: Momentum after liquidity shocks should behave differently from ordinary trend following and may reveal reversal/fragility boundaries.
falsification_criteria: liquidity shock context does not improve candidate survival or exposes only turnover noise

templates.label: Momentum confirmation
templates.hypothesis_template: A weak value or quality signal should be validated only when price action confirms improving expectations.
falsification_criteria: momentum confirmation fails to reduce drawdown or improve positive spread
